about: Layer registry: every input the dashboard uses or has tried. Ladder: idea -> tested -> info -> proven -> approved -> live (retired). Only approved/live layers may affect the picks. See breadth/research.py and DECISIONS.md.

layers.name: Breadth regime
layers.what: Stockbee-style 4% up/down ratios, T2108 -> strong / mixed / weak / thrust

layers.name: Playbook state + setup verdicts
layers.what: post-thrust or breadth regime; each setup Focus / Selective / Avoid by backtested R in that state

layers.name: Thrust watch (live)
layers.what: live 4% up count vs 40-day avg; thrust pace >= 2.5x

layers.name: Washout thrust card
layers.what: thrusts after SPY -8% and T2108 <= 25 -> high-beta RS 80+ leaders for ~1 month

layers.name: Money in or out (dollar share)
layers.what: share of $ volume in falling stocks; >= 70% days followed by SPY +1.3% next 5

layers.name: Volume tilt
layers.what: relvol of up movers vs down movers, 10-day; low outside thrust windows -> SPY -4% next 21

layers.name: Narrowing / highs context
layers.what: many stocks near highs followed by weaker SPY 20d (context)

layers.name: Theme / sub-theme Strength
layers.what: relative perf + EMA breadth + median RS, 0-100

layers.name: Rotation: leading & accelerating
layers.what: group line above rising 20-day, near 60-day high, top 20% 20d -> ideas

layers.name: Money flow tiers (RRG)
layers.what: confirmed / steady / new / fading / outflow per sub-theme

layers.name: Group ignition + Day 1
layers.what: 4-check ignition; Day 1 breakout needs 3-day follow-through

layers.name: Pick context re-rank
layers.what: +1 ignited sub-theme; in outflow episodes +1 sold-hardest / -1 held-up group
layers.notes: · Oct 27 2026: retired with the old Top 2 swing picks (Adam: headline picks = Launch picks + Lined-up buys); still logged quietly. It now only re-ranks the retired Top 2 list, which no longer shows on the page, so it no longer affects any headline pick.

layers.name: RS Rating + leaders score
layers.what: RS 1-99; leaders = 60% RS + 40% closeness to high

layers.name: Trade setups (ATH, pullback, rotation, Q-flag, VCP, round number, box retest, box spring)
layers.what: setup masks + backtest by state

layers.name: Conviction tags
layers.what: RS high/ahead, burst, coil, top theme...; none adds edge at t >= 2

layers.name: Record volume warning
layers.what: up days on record volume lagged SPY ~-5% over 10 sessions

layers.name: Macro fit (rates / oil / dollar)
layers.what: market-neutral sensitivities + 5-day tailwind; failed its backtest

layers.name: Calendar (earnings + events)
layers.what: earnings inside the hold, high-impact events; forward-logged

layers.name: Catalyst (why it's moving)
layers.what: direction / quality / red flags with sources; forward-logged

layers.name: Macro brief
layers.where: agent 7:02 AM ET → docs/agent/macro_brief.json → Read-out 'Macro & the week ahead' card (macroBriefCard); also still read by decision.py (quiet log)
layers.what: rates, Fed, oil, geopolitics, event risk; forward-logged
layers.notes: · Oct 27 2026: kept (Adam: important); shown as the 'Macro & the week ahead' card on the Read-out since the Decision Cards were retired.

layers.name: Position-trade exits
layers.what: 3-month holds: hold or 50-EMA trail beat 10/21-EMA trails

layers.name: Sizing high-ADR leaders
layers.what: size so a ~30% drawdown is ~1% of account instead of adding names

layers.name: Hidden buying (FINRA short share)
layers.what: S&P 500 off-exchange short share 5-day vs 120-day normal; top fifth -> SPY +3.1% next 21 (experimental)

layers.name: Who won the close
layers.what: descriptive: where stocks closed in their range; no forward edge

layers.name: Strength on Weakness (weekly position setup)
layers.where: breadth/sow.py → DATA.themes.sow, Trade Setups tab sowCard
layers.what: weekly stage-1 base + 9/21 WEMA re-anchor; breakout / nuzzle / pop states for multi-month holds
layers.notes: beats the average stock but not other RS 70+ stocks yet; only ~1 year testable

layers.name: Market health (leaders + breakouts working)
layers.what: leaders' breakouts/breakdowns, 50-day recovery check, universe base breakouts vs breakdowns and follow-through
layers.notes: no forward edge in 410 days; untested in a bear market

layers.name: The trade (main rotation: winning vs losing groups)
layers.where: breadth/thetrade.py → DATA.themes.thetrade, Read-out tradeCard + story fact sheet
layers.what: names the top-fifth vs bottom-fifth sub-theme rotation (20 sessions), its state vs the ratio's 20-day avg, and whether the winners hold up on the losers' best days (real buying) or give back (seesaw)
layers.notes: holds-up winners +1.1% vs avg group next 10 (t 2.0, both halves) but basket momentum overall t 1.5; 'gives back' snapback 5 of 5 settled episodes, n small

layers.name: Trade Stories (running news/earnings narratives with a price check)
layers.owner: Market Monitor story · after the close
layers.where: breadth/stories.py + stories_guide.md → docs/stories.json, Trade Stories tab (renderStories)
layers.what: max 6 open storylines: thesis, sourced timeline, favoured/hurt sub-themes, catalysts, how to trade; code price check + 5-session scorecard per story-day

layers.name: Stair steps (groups nuzzling into the 9/21 EMAs and stepping up together)
layers.what: per stock: nuzzled / lifting / step break vs the 9/21 EMAs and the last 15-session step high; per sub-theme: setting up together (50%+ nuzzled) / stepping up together (40%+ lifting or breaking after nuzzling), 15-session strip
layers.notes: alone ≈ average group; inside top-30% (60d) groups setting up +2.2% vs other leaders over 20 sessions (t 1.9, both halves), stepping up +1.7% (t 2.0); pure step breaks lagged

layers.name: Box trades: ★ My favorites (leading-group box longs)
layers.where: template.html isBoxFav/boxFavRank → Box trades card (Trade Setups tab), from DATA.themes.boxes + DATA.themes.stairs
layers.what: long box trades actionable now (retest go/at, spring failed), grade A–B, in a ★ leading group (top 30% on 60-day), reward:risk ≥ 1.5 from the last close; top 5
layers.notes: ★ leading group on retest bounces +0.23R vs −0.02R (t 3.2, both halves) — passes the proven rule but NOT wired into box grades/playbook (needs Adam's approval) · Oct 27 2026: Adam approved; '★ Leading group' is a box-grade condition (expected R) and counts as group confluence for the Box Retest / Box Spring playbook setups.

layers.name: Dip buys: Box + SoW names under / wicking under the daily 9-21 EMAs
layers.where: breadth/dips.py → DATA.themes.dips → dipCard at the top of Trade Setups and on the Intraday tab (live from the Google Sheet price + column L low)
layers.what: Box longs (retest_long, trap_long failed) + every SoW row; flags under 9/21, wick under and close back above, reclaim within 3 sessions; live EMA = last EMA + alpha x (price - last EMA)
layers.notes: generic test: no edge vs any uptrend day (entry-location tool only)

layers.name: Launch list: base breakouts graded on the tells of the ones that went
layers.where: breadth/launch.py → DATA.themes.launch (picks, pick_bt, tracker) → Launch list tab + top of Trade Setups + Read-out plan; data/launch_ledger.csv
layers.what: Fresh base breakouts (20+ of 40 weeks under the 50 WEMA, now 2-8 weekly closes over it, 9 > rising 21, within 3 weekly ATRs) + every SoW row; points: sub-theme top third on 13-wk return, RS 70+, RS line +15% in 13 wks, 6%+ gap day in 13 wks; grade A = group + 2-3 others, B = group + 0-1, C = no group
layers.notes: Approved by Adam Oct 25 2026 as the headline picks. Proof: grade A minus C 13w vs SPY by week, fresh t 3.1 (halves +15/+19%), curl t 2.5 (+33/+28%). Pick rule replay (top 3 a week, stops, weekly ATR <= 15%): +9.7% vs SPY over 13 wks, t 3.66, halves +11.4/+8.7%, median ~0, beat SPY 49%, worst -38%. Live check: data/launch_ledger.csv

layers.name: Best Setups: EMA pullbacks + high tight flags inside leading groups
layers.what: Leading group = sub-theme top third on 13-wk return; nuzzle = leader (9+ wks over 50 WEMA) touching the daily 9/21 ribbon; flag = 30%+ leg, tight flag within 1 ADR of the high
layers.notes: nuzzle in leading groups +0.19R vs rest, t 2.57, both halves (passes); flags edge t 2.96 but 2nd half -0.04R (fails); recomputed each build

layers.name: Theme lifecycle: stage per sub-theme, WATCH / BUY signals, tickers to buy
layers.where: breadth/lifecycle.py → DATA.themes.lifecycle → Best Setups tab (lifecycleCard) + Read-out group signals
layers.what: Stages forgotten / first push / ignition / quiet build / blossom / fading from 60-day rank, 60-day high, ignition, money-flow tiers; WATCH = push or ignition with leaders; BUY = build or blossom + leaders + confirmed/steady flow, breadth not weak (full size when the 10-day ratio hit 1.5 in 15 sessions); tickers = RS 70+ members at a pullback / flag / curl
layers.notes: BUY groups +2.7% vs avg group over 20 sessions (t 3.5, halves +2.8/+2.9), 40d +3.9%; same setup in weak breadth ~0 (t -0.5); WATCH ~0 but 53% turn BUY within 30 sessions; pullbacks in BUY groups +0.74R vs +0.27R elsewhere (edge +0.31R, t 2.2, both halves); recomputed each build · Oct 27 2026: Lined-up buys made a headline list (Adam), on the Best Setups tab; the catalyst agent researches them first.

layers.name: Earnings clusters: several members of one group reacting the same way in a week
layers.where: breadth/earnings.py → DATA.themes.earnings → Trade Stories tab (earningsCard) + story fact sheet EARNINGS CLUSTERS → chapter 'What earnings said'
layers.what: Earnings-style day = gap ≥ max(3%, 1 ADR) on 2.5x 50-day volume; cluster = 2+ in a sub-theme within 5 sessions, 2/3 same way; read-through = members that didn't report; writer confirms what the reports said
layers.notes: UP cluster → not-yet-reported members +1.9% vs avg group next 20 sessions (t 1.93, halves +1.9/+1.9); DOWN → ~0; recomputed each build

layers.name: Top late mover: highest-RS leading-group stock catching a bid since 10:00 (12:00 ET)
layers.where: template.html lateLeader → top of the Intraday tab's Second-half movers card
layers.what: At 12:00 ET: RS 80+, sub-theme top third on 13 weeks, up 1%+ since 10:00 and beating SPY, $20M+/day → highest RS
layers.notes: 15-min bars Oct 2024–Oct 2026 (~700 stocks, 431 days): 5-day +0.21R, +0.15R vs avg stock (t 1.3, halves +0.15/+0.15); same-day/next-day ≈ 0R; biggest-mover ranking worse

layers.name: Runners: groups running together (live alert)
layers.what: Sub-theme 75%+ up, avg 1.25+ ADRs, +3 pts vs SPY, 1.2x paced volume -> phone alert + Intraday Runners card; strong = 1.5 ADRs on 1.5x
layers.notes: Daily follow-through passed (next day +0.34% t 2.25, 5d +0.90% t 2.47); intraday continuation forward-logged in data/runner_log.csv
